condition: In plotly 5.x, the error message says to run `pip install -U kaleido`, which installs kaleido 1.0+. That version is not compatible with plotly 5.x, so static image export with write_image/to_image fails.
workaround: Pin kaleido below 1.0 (`pip install "kaleido<1.0.0"`, e.g. 0.2.1), or upgrade plotly to 6.1.1 or later.
